example_sentences_in_bangla: তার আধিব্যাধির কারণে সে কাজ করতে পারছে না।
আধিব্যাধি থেকে মুক্তি পাওয়া খুব কঠিন।
example_sentences_in_english: He can't work because of his mental and physical diseases.
Recovery from mental and physical ailments is very difficult.
history: The idiom stems from the traditional Bengali belief encapsulated in the saying 'ব্যাধির চেয়ে আধি হল বড়', emphasizing that mental suffering is greater than physical pain.
note: Highlights the cultural prioritization of mental over physical health in Bengali folklore.
